event.title: 8-K: Other Events — Completed sale by controlling stockholder

evidence.text: On October 29, 2026, Zenith Arc Robotics Inc. (the "Company") was notified by Atlas Holdings LP, its controlling stockholder, that Atlas completed the sale of 4.5% of the Company's outstanding common stock in a registered secondary offering.
evidence.passageText: Item 8.01 Other Events. On October 29, 2026, Zenith Arc Robotics Inc. (the "Company") was notified by Atlas Holdings LP, its controlling stockholder, that Atlas completed the sale of 4.5% of the Company's outstanding common stock in a registered secondary offering. Following the sale, Atlas continues to hold approximately 31.0% of the outstanding common stock. The Company did not receive any proceeds from the sale.
